title: M 3.9 Experimental Explosion – 147 Km ENE of Ponce Inlet, Florida
summary: USGS reported a magnitude 3.9 earthquake located 147 km east-northeast of Ponce Inlet, Florida, generated 63 points on Hacker News with 39 comments discussing the seismic event.
problem_solved: Provides real-time earthquake monitoring and public reporting for a minor seismic event off the Florida coast.
why_valuable: Offers transparent, scientifically verified earthquake data enabling public awareness, emergency preparedness, and geological research.
